- Overall performance: Revenue after eliminations is INR 857.23 billion with a gross margin of 51.4% and EBITDA margin of 33.9%.
- The company that contributes most to revenue is Wipro Consumer Care International with INR 445.37 billion, while the one that needs attention is Wipro Consumer Care India due to its lower EBITDA margin of 17.7% compared to Wipro Consumer Care International's 48.8%.
- Margins are at 51.4% for gross margin and 33.9% for EBITDA margin, indicating a significant difference between the two.
- Working capital as of 2026-07-01 is influenced by days sales outstanding (DSO) of 147 days and days payables outstanding (DPO) of 409 days.
- Top 3 revenue drivers are: everything excluding profit centre US10_PECS with a revenue change of INR 49.52 billion (86.4% of total change), SAP product sales (GL 41000000) excluding entity 310 Wipro Consumer Care India - South (310), profit centre US10_PECS with a revenue change of INR 41.49 billion (72.4% of total change), and SAP product sales (GL 41000000) excluding entity 310 Wipro Consumer Care India - South (310), entity USC1 Wipro Consumer Care International - US Corporate (USC1), profit centre US10_PECS, profit centre US10_PEML, profit centre US10_PEMS, profit centre US10_PLX with a revenue change of INR 22.13 billion (38.6% of total change).
